title: Equilibration versus Localization in a Diffusion-Relaxation System
summary: We consider a diffusion-relaxation system and investigate the conditions on parameters leading to equilibration versus localization. When the diffusion is dominant, solutions converge toward homogeneous equilibria. By contrast, when the effective diffusion is weak, localization emerges. Such behaviors have been studied for various models through formal asymptotic arguments and linearized stability analysis, but rigorous understanding of the associated nonlinear phenomena remains limited, particularly in higher dimensions.
